title: Draymond Green on Rockets: 'Do they do some b****** when we play them? Yes, but I'm not going to sit here and call them a dirty team'
text:
Draymond Green on Rockets: 'Do they do some b****** when we play them? Yes, but I'm not going to sit here and call them a dirty team' Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Draymond Green on Rockets: 'Do they do some b****** when we play them? Yes, but I'm not going to sit here and call them a dirty team'
 HoopsHype Nov. 13, 2026, 1:37 p.m. ET Draymond Green disagrees that Rockets are a dirty team: 'I don’t get off into the dirty thing. Every now and then you see some people that just do things that are down right dirty. And it happens and when it does, I’ll speak on it. Do they do some bullsh*t when we play them? Absolutely. I think the thing is that may irritate me the most is like they play super physical but then they start flopping sometimes, you know? So, I would say like that irritates me more, but I’m not going to sit here and call them dirty team.'
